messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: 'DB-Cache: high accept-queue / pgbouncer saturation' fired for service=redwood-cache-eu-west, severity=critical. Alert groups: redis/pgbouncer. Links: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: AUTO-PAGE -> ryan (oncall), kira (sre). Escalation level 1.

ryan (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. jumping into metrics and pgbouncer stats now.

ryan (oncall): quick look: redis latency spiking ~150-300ms 95p, accepted connections ~maxclients near threshold, pgbouncer client_wait_queue rising. Possibly connection churn from a batch job?

mohit (eng-db): I see a burst of connections from worker-scale group 'embedder-v2' since 1934567600. They opened many short-lived DB connections. Logs show repeated connect/close loops.

kira (sre): noted. Can we confirm pgbouncer stats? ryan, paste output of `show pools` if possible.

ryan (oncall): running now — output snippet:
```
SHOW POOLS;
database users total cl_active cl_waiting sv_active sv_idle
redwood main 350 260 90 40 20
```
Looks like cl_waiting ~90 on main DB. client_wait_queue is very high.

mohit (eng-db): That matches PG acceptqueue behavior, pgbouncer is saturated. We can temporarily raise max_client_conn and pool_size on the pgbouncer pool for redwood-main to buy time, but we should fix the job.

ana (support): Any customer-visible impact? I have one ticket from EU customers complaining about 502s in the search/embedding flow.

ryan (oncall): yes, partial: search and autocompete latencies & occasional errors. RPS stable but tail latency elevated. We'll mark impacted customer segments: EU region, high-embedding tenants.

kira (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) Increase pgbouncer max_client_conn by +200 (rolling). 2) Temporarily route embedder-v2 traffic to a cold pool (rate-limit) — Mohit, can you add a filter in the traffic router? 3) Identify and kill runaway connections if they exceed 1min idle. 4) If not improving in 5m, scale up read-replica capacity and enable fallback reads.

mohit (eng-db): Applying router filter now: `curl -X POST https://router/api/blocks -d '{"source":"embedder-v2","rate_limit":10}'` -> 200 OK. Also bumping pgbouncer config: `max_client_conn=1200` -> reload.

ryan (oncall): pgbouncer reload done. client_waiting halved in 60s. redis accept queue still noisy but connections down 40%.

pagerduty-bot: ryan (oncall) acknowledged incident INC12345 at 1934567922. Escalation suspended.

ana (support): passing note to affected support tickets: "We've applied temporary rate limits and increased DB pool capacity; engineers are monitoring. Expect improvements within minutes."

kira (sre): Watchlist: redis clients ~maxclients, pgbouncer cl_waiting, worker churn. Next steps: Mohit to run `pgbouncer-show` every 30s and open a small canary scaling if waiting persists. If all stable in 15m we'll start handoff.

mohit (eng-db): setting up 30s poll and alert at >50 waiting. Also grabbed slow-query snippet from PG:
```
SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE state='pending' AND created_at < now() - interval '1 minute' LIMIT 1000;
-- many of these are old workers re-queuing and reconnecting repeatedly
```
I'm adding a guard to backoff the job reenqueue loop.

ryan (oncall): metrics look improved: 95p latency back to ~70ms, cl_waiting ~12. Marking incident as 'mitigated' for now. Will remain active for postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 status: mitigated by ryan (oncall) at 1934567985. Please follow runbook: create postmortem, owner=mohit, severity=high, customer-impact=partial EU for embeds.

kira (sre): Handoff note for night: follow up on job backoff change, consider permanent rate limits for embedder-v2, propose autoscale for pgbouncer pools in playbook. Assigning to mohit.

ana (support): I'll update tickets: summary + mitigation + ETA for root cause analysis.

ryan (oncall): Thanks team. Closing Slack thread but keeping PD incident open until RCA complete. :thumbsup:
